method: Translate each fixed pose vertically until its lowest box/capsule support feature touches the floor. Retain all contact-body masks and positive normal/friction-cone moment masks about the mass-weighted whole-body center of mass. Check all 28 nonadjacent body pairs using exact segment/segment or segment/box distances; only the eight connected pairs are excluded. Compare selected witnesses with independent scalar world-frame kinematics and all relevant retained continuous-joint reach exclusions.
qualification_economy: New observables: nonadjacent surface separation and signed floor-contact moment arms, including tied support features and optimistic friction-cone bounds. Existing reach and height screens cannot express these. Reuse PoseGeometry, RigidTree, pose_pool, retained compiled bodies, source/runtime bindings, contained stages, the operation mutex and inventories. A shared geometry owner now accepts a diagnostic module; historical owners remain unchanged. One reusable mathematics module and its focused controls add no native campaign gate or evaluator.
selection_provenance: All 334 bodies and the nine-state factored limb bank are exposed predecessors. The 512 uniform and 512 edge samples use a new declared deterministic seed. Geometric witnesses are proposal material, not a frozen native shortlist or held-out evaluation.
limits: Finite body, joint-pose and orientation samples only; no continuous coverage or recovery impossibility claim.
A floor-supported pose is a geometric construction. No native root is moved, no world is opened and no transition into that pose is proved.
Nonadjacent overlap is a separate plausibility filter. Retained native XML disables robot self-collision; its collision policy is not changed and no previous native eligibility is revised.
Negative segment-to-box surface gap signals overlap; its magnitude is not a certified minimum translation or penetration depth.

Moment arms are torque per unit normal force, in metres. Friction-cone upper bounds are optimistic single-contact possibilities using the retained sliding coefficient; joint effort, force balance, torsional/rolling friction and actual native forces are not solved.

Supporting face/line vertices retain moment extrema; contacts within the declared numerical band are included. Positive moment alone does not establish useful motion, feasible force allocation or a dynamic controller.
Changing which contact is used or combining different pose witnesses does not prove a realizable trajectory. Momentum and contact switching require fresh native evidence.
No training, Tier 2, Tier 3, recovery, real-time, physical acceptance or release authority.
